candidates.snippet: A boy lost his footing while standing on a restaurant chair in Suzhou, east China, only for an attentive waiter to break the fall. The child escaped unharmed thanks to the quick reaction. #Kindness #Heartwarming #China https://t.co/6KDADvizhS

A home-raised pig fell into a ditch after being chased by a dog in north China's Tianjin. With its owner unable to get it out, local firefighters worked together to pull the pig to safety. #Tianjin #Firefighters #AnimalRescue #China https://t.co/2COtvc8E2l

China's green hero #YinYuzhen gave a special hand-made suit to her American friend #RonaldSakolsky upon their recent meeting at World Food Forum in Rome. #Sakolsky, wearing a Chinese Tang suit, brought Yin a Pittsburgh Steelers hoodie from his hometown.
